The University of Michigan updated its consumer sentiment index Friday with a preliminary August reading of 51, down about 8% from the final July index reading of 55.2.

The final August consumer sentiment index will be released on the 28th.

The school’s consumer sentiment tracker goes back decades and hit an all-time low in May. It had shown improvement across June and July before the downturn this month. [...] View PDF

The University of Michigan researchers collect nationwide surveys each month – asking people about business conditions, buying conditions, and personal finances – and use the feedback to calculate a consumer sentiment index.
